hypotheses.B1_leading_top8_channels_recur: Mean pairwise Jaccard overlap of leading-address top-eight absolute-Shapley channel sets is at least 0.50.
hypotheses.B2_shared_top4_captures_half_operator: The four-channel aggregate backbone reconstructs at least half of every leading address operator's natural-metric energy.
hypotheses.B3_shared_top16_is_sufficient: The 16-channel aggregate backbone reconstructs at least 80% of every leading address operator's natural-metric energy.
hypotheses.B4_backbone_is_leading_address_specific: Median shared-top16 R-squared is at least twice as large for leading addresses as for sign-null and random controls.
hypotheses.B5_shapley_profiles_have_shared_rank1_ba: The leading normalized absolute-Shapley profile matrix has at least 80% of its energy in the first singular component.
hypotheses.B6_residual_after_backbone_remains_broad: After removing shared top 16, median leading residual singular K90 is at least 32.
hypotheses.B7_backbone_channels_are_not_the_whole_c: At least three leading addresses remain below operator R-squared 0.90 after shared top 128 channels.
hypotheses.B8_shared_backbone_preserves_output_role: For every leading address, the shared-top16 operator retains at least half the full operator's energy in the leading output direction.
